notes: 修 apply 合并工作区登记表时的两个会拖垮工作区列表的问题：① 同一路径出现两个工作区（换机时本机自建的 default-workspace 与仓库里那条 ID 不同，按 ID 合并必然撞车）会让 DSH 启动校验 duplicate paths 失败、整张登记表打不开，表现为左侧工作区列表全空、历史会话也读不出来；现在合并后按 path 去重，同路径只留一条并把另一条的会话并进来。② 会话 id 集合里会混进空串（PowerShell 里 $null 过管道被 [string] 化成 ""），现在统一滤掉，不再写出 [""]。
notesEn: Fixes two registry-merge bugs that can blank the workspace list. (1) Two workspaces sharing one path — a machine's self-created default-workspace and the repo copy have different IDs, so merging by ID always collides — trip DSH's duplicate-paths check at startup, which makes the whole registry unreadable: the workspace list is empty and history cannot be loaded. apply now de-duplicates by path, keeping one entry and merging the other's sessions into it. (2) Empty strings leaked into session-id sets (PowerShell turns $null into ""), so [""] got written; they are now filtered out.
